scripts.check: pnpm --filter web check && pnpm --filter studio check && pnpm --filter scheduler check
scripts.seed:build: pnpm --filter studio exec node seed/build-seed.ts > apps/studio/seed/sample.ndjson
scripts.seed:import: pnpm --filter studio exec sanity datasets import seed/sample.ndjson --dataset production --replace
scripts.smoke: cd apps/studio && pnpm exec sanity exec scripts/smoke-redirects.ts --with-user-token && pnpm exec sanity exec scripts/smoke-scheduler.ts --with-user-token && pnpm exec sanity exec scripts/smoke-backup.ts --with-user-token
scripts.preview:worker: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter web preview:worker
